column3: Hi, we are BlockID, from Sydney. This is BlockID Business Passport: know the business you invest in. In the next few minutes we'll show the core features, the user flow for investors and for businesses, the technology underneath, and where the project is today.

Why does this matter? Investing in a business is hard to follow, and the numbers are hard to trust. After you invest, you lose sight of sales, profit and new shares. Ownership sits in a spreadsheet, so your stake can shrink and nobody tells you. And dividends are slow, or never arrive.
So we built one passport per business. Every investor can understand it, follow it, own it, get paid, and check it for themselves.

This is the live app at eth dot blockid dot au, running on testnet. There is no sign-up and no wallet to install: on your first visit you land in a shared demo investor account, with sample data. My portfolio shows every business you hold, what your shares are worth at the latest approved price, and the dividends already paid to your wallet.

Open a holding. You see your shares and your stake, a price that only moves when a new value is checked and approved, the dividends paid to your wallet, and the business updates: revenue, gross profit and net result. Every investor gets the same update at the same time.

Now the business side, which is also how an investor checks any business. Paste a website. We check the address first, then the research starts. A business can add its own numbers to improve the result.

Research runs as a team of AI agents, and each step reports as it finishes: read the website, build the business profile, find competitors and market data within a fixed budget of web searches, analyse the market, and score. The agents hold no keys. They can only propose.

The result is a plain valuation report: a grade from A to E, a business score, and a low, mid and high value. Each part explains its score, and every figure links to the page it came from. A finding that cites a page the agent never read is dropped. No source, no number.

Nothing moves further until a person approves it. The admin console lists every waiting item in flow order: valuations, issuance, chain sync, new shares, dividends, updates and offerings. Approvals are signed by an admin wallet, and only then does the issuer act.

After approval, the isolated issuer, the only part with a key, creates the share register on BlockID chain and copies it to Ethereum Hoodi and HashKey Chain. This cap table is read straight from the chain: every holder, wallet and share count.

From the same workspace, a business can open a share offering, and investors see the dilution before any new shares are issued. A dividend rule is approved once. After twenty-four hours to cancel, it is paid to every wallet, and holders pay no gas.

Check it. Don't trust us. The verify page hashes the full report in your browser and compares it with the hash recorded on three blockchains. All three match. Now change one number, and the check turns red.

On HashKey Chain we run the real-world asset stack: identity registry, share token, dividend distributor and cap table anchor, plus our AgentProvenance contract, which records which agent proposed each action and which person approved it.

Investors also back people. Our second app, BlockID HR, reviews the founding team. It reads public professional information, and a CV when one is given, then checks each requirement of the role: met, partly met, or not found, and whether the evidence is verified. Not found is never treated as false, and every score links to its sources.

Under the hood, only approved actions reach the chain. AI analysis runs with no keys. An admin wallet signs one approval. Only then does the isolated issuer act, and AgentProvenance records who proposed and who approved. Agents propose. Humans approve. Chains prove.

Where are we today? The whole flow runs live on testnet, with fourteen sample listings built from public information, forty-two share token contracts on three chains, and every report verified on chain. Since the Sydney demo we added founding team reviews with CV checks, an improved valuation model, and terms and privacy pages. More than five hundred automated tests run on every change. We have no real users yet.

Next: our first pilot businesses in Australia and Vietnam, investor communities, and licensed partners for custody and offerings. Agents propose. Humans approve. Chains prove. Try it yourself at eth dot blockid dot au. Thank you.
